//: Type-check configuration for supabase/functions/, used only by scripts/check-functions-types.mjs. It lives at the repository root, and not inside supabase/functions/, on purpose: `supabase functions deploy` reads that directory, and a config file there would become an input to production deploys for the sake of a CI check. Deno never discovers this file on its own -- it only looks for deno.json/deno.jsonc -- so it applies exclusively when passed with --config.
//jsx: auth-email-hook renders React Email templates (_shared/email-templates/*.tsx). Its own supabase/functions/auth-email-hook/deno.json carries these same settings for the deploy path; --config overrides discovery, so the check path needs them too. Harmless for the other eleven functions, which have no .tsx in their import graph.
//nodeModulesDir: Without this, the root package.json makes Deno resolve npm: specifiers through node_modules and fail on standardwebhooks, which npm has no reason to install. 'none' sends them to Deno's own cache, which is how the functions actually run in production.
